LevelMeter.summary: Passes audio through while the host-side EffeTune app can display peak and RMS levels.

Oscilloscope.summary: Passes audio through while the host-side EffeTune app can display its waveform.

Spectrogram.summary: Passes audio through while the host-side EffeTune app can display frequency content over time.

SpectrumAnalyzer.summary: Passes audio through while the host-side EffeTune app can display its frequency spectrum.

StereoMeter.summary: Passes audio through while the host-side EffeTune app can display stereo level and phase relationships.

ChannelDivider.summary: Routes an input channel into selected output channels according to its semantic parameters.

DCOffset.summary: Adds a controllable constant offset to the signal.

FIRCrossover.summary: Applies an externally prepared FIR crossover impulse response.

Matrix.summary: Mixes input channels into output channels using an explicit routing matrix.

MultiChannelPanel.summary: Applies per-channel gain, mute, solo, and delay controls to multichannel audio.

PolarityInversion.summary: Inverts the polarity of the selected channels.

StereoBalance.summary: Adjusts the relative level of the left and right channels.

Volume.summary: Applies a precise gain in decibels.

Delay.summary: Adds a delayed signal with controllable feedback and mix.

TimeAlignment.summary: Delays selected channels to align arrival times.

AutoLeveler.summary: Adjusts gain gradually toward a configured target level.

BrickwallLimiter.summary: Restricts peaks to a configured ceiling with look-ahead limiting.

Compressor.summary: Reduces dynamic range above a configurable threshold.

Expander.summary: Increases dynamic contrast below a configurable threshold.

Gate.summary: Attenuates signals below a configurable threshold.

MultibandCompressor.summary: Applies independent compression to multiple frequency bands.

MultibandExpander.summary: Applies independent expansion to multiple frequency bands.

MultibandTransient.summary: Shapes transient and sustain energy independently across frequency bands.

PowerAmpSag.summary: Models level-dependent power-supply sag and recovery.

TransientShaper.summary: Adjusts attack and sustain without using a fixed threshold.

BandPassFilter.summary: Retains a configurable frequency band while attenuating frequencies outside it.

CombFilter.summary: Creates regularly spaced spectral notches and peaks with a short delay.

EarphoneCableSim.summary: Models the frequency response caused by earphone cable impedance.

FifteenBandGEQ.summary: Provides fifteen fixed-frequency graphic equalizer bands.

FifteenBandPEQ.summary: Provides fifteen configurable parametric equalizer bands.

FiveBandDynamicEQ.summary: Applies level-dependent equalization in five configurable bands.

FiveBandFIRPEQ.summary: Applies an externally prepared FIR response for five-band equalization.

FiveBandPEQ.summary: Provides five configurable parametric equalizer bands.

GroupDelayEQ.summary: Applies an externally prepared FIR response to adjust group delay.

HiPassFilter.summary: Attenuates frequencies below a configurable cutoff.

LoPassFilter.summary: Attenuates frequencies above a configurable cutoff.

LoudnessEqualizer.summary: Applies level-dependent frequency compensation based on equal-loudness behavior.

NarrowRange.summary: Restricts audio to a configurable frequency range.

RoomEQ.summary: Applies an externally prepared room-correction impulse response.

TiltEQ.summary: Tilts the tonal balance around a configurable pivot frequency.

ToneControl.summary: Adjusts bass, midrange, and treble with broad tone-control curves.

AMRadioSimulator.summary: Models bandwidth, distortion, interference, and noise associated with AM radio.

BitCrusher.summary: Reduces amplitude resolution and sample-rate fidelity for digital quantization effects.

DigitalErrorEmulator.summary: Introduces deterministic seeded digital transmission errors at a controlled rate.

DSD64IMDSimulator.summary: Models ultrasonic-noise intermodulation artifacts associated with DSD64 playback.

FMRadioSimulator.summary: Models bandwidth, stereo behavior, distortion, and noise associated with FM radio.

HumGenerator.summary: Adds power-line hum and harmonics at controlled levels.

NoiseBlender.summary: Adds a configurable blend of generated noise colors.

SWRadioSimulator.summary: Models fading, interference, limited bandwidth, and noise associated with shortwave radio.

VinylArtifacts.summary: Adds deterministic seeded clicks, crackle, and surface artifacts.

VinylSimulator.summary: Combines tonal, mechanical, and surface-noise behavior associated with vinyl playback.

DopplerDistortion.summary: Modulates delay to model pitch movement caused by changing distance.

PitchShifter.summary: Shifts pitch while retaining the input duration.

Tremolo.summary: Modulates amplitude periodically at a configurable rate and depth.

WowFlutter.summary: Applies slow and fast pitch variation associated with imperfect mechanical playback.

Oscillator.summary: Generates a periodic test tone without requiring an input signal.

HornResonator.summary: Applies a horn-like resonant response to the input.

HornResonatorPlus.summary: Applies an extended multi-mode horn-like resonant response.

ModalResonator.summary: Excites configurable resonant modes from the input signal.

DattorroPlateReverb.summary: Creates a plate-style reverberation using a Dattorro-inspired network.

FDNReverb.summary: Creates reverberation with a feedback delay network.

IRReverb.summary: Convolves audio with a caller-supplied impulse response.

RSReverb.summary: Creates algorithmic reverberation with configurable room and decay behavior.

DynamicSaturation.summary: Applies saturation whose drive responds to the input level.

Exciter.summary: Generates controlled high-frequency harmonics to emphasize detail.

HardClipping.summary: Limits waveform amplitude abruptly at a configurable threshold.

HarmonicDistortion.summary: Adds configurable harmonic components derived from the input.

MultibandSaturation.summary: Applies independent saturation to multiple frequency bands.

Saturation.summary: Applies smooth nonlinear distortion with controllable drive and mix.

SubSynth.summary: Derives low-frequency harmonic content from the input signal.

CrossfeedFilter.summary: Feeds a filtered portion of each stereo channel into the opposite channel.

MSMatrix.summary: Encodes, decodes, or adjusts mid-side stereo components.

MultibandBalance.summary: Adjusts left-right balance independently across frequency bands.

StereoBlend.summary: Blends stereo channels to adjust width and channel separation.
